subject.title: feat: inspect background tasks across web and mobile

question: Should tasks.get expose bounded task prompt text to every authenticated operator.read client, including the bounded mobile bootstrap operator token?
rationale: Current main describes task RPCs as sanitized summaries, while this PR adds potentially sensitive task input without introducing a distinct permission boundary; the intended confidentiality contract requires maintainer authority.

options.title: Approve read-scoped detail
options.body: Keep prompt on tasks.get under operator.read, document the disclosure contract, and retain tests proving prompts never enter list responses or events.

options.title: Require stronger authorization
options.body: Restrict prompt detail to operator.admin or a new explicit scope and update web/mobile authorization and recovery UX accordingly.

recommendation.title: Approve read-scoped detail
recommendation.body: Keep prompt on tasks.get under operator.read, document the disclosure contract, and retain tests proving prompts never enter list responses or events.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation spans Gateway policy plus first-party web and native clients, and their history is the strongest cross-surface ownership signal available.
